blockers: The revised matrix removes the previous structural collinearity, but the proposed action-alignment terms are not sufficient to identify the required profile-specific reorganisation.
The primary contrast currently averages action-alignment coefficients and therefore tests generic action–future alignment, not the frozen action×profile×future permutation reorganisation.
The model must encode mapping alignment at the action×profile level (or an algebraically equivalent permutation-indexed interaction) while avoiding deterministic redundancy with condition.
gate_decision: BLOCK. The estimand must be represented at action×profile level before rank/estimability can be accepted.
next_action: Implement permutation-indexed action×profile alignment features that distinguish identity alignment from reassigned alignment, then derive the primary contrast as the frozen mapping-following reorganisation.
